issues.detail: 58 element(s) declare a single font-family with no fallback — layout shift risk if the font fails/metrics differ.

notes: Font metrics analysis: @font-face declarations cross-referenced with computed font-family usage and document.fonts load status.
In JSDOM, document.fonts and layout metrics are limited — @font-face CSSOM analysis remains real; load-status is reported only when the API exists.
